source.data_source: Coles, D. & Wadcock, A. J. (1979) flying-hot-wire study at alpha=13.87 deg, Re_c=1.52e6. TMR distributes naca4412.cp.expt.dat (surface Cp) and exp.profiles.new.dat (BL profiles). RANS predictions on this case span CL ~ 1.62 (SST) to ~ 1.72 (SA) per TMR per-model pages.
source.physics: Massive trailing-edge separation on the upper surface near maximum lift; canonical APG / near-stall benchmark. Strong turbulence-model sensitivity — gt_values are anchored to RANS-consensus mid-band (with experiment as uncertainty band) and tolerances widened accordingly.
source.experimental_uncertainty: Coles & Wadcock 1979 quote CL ~ 1.49 at alpha=13.87 deg for the experimental case. Most published RANS bracket the experimental value with model-dependent over/under-prediction. T_good widened to ~0.10 to accommodate cross-model scatter.

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the airfoil mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: TMR coarsest grid is 113x33 (~3.7k); a wall-resolved 2D RANS (y+<1) at near-stall conditions typically requires 80k-200k cells with extra refinement near the upper surface. Hand-set.

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the momentum equation
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Hand-set — looser than other cases because near-stall flows often won't fully steady-converge below 1e-3 (TMR notes this case stalls at ~1e-3 to 1e-4 for SST and SA models).

cl.description: Lift coefficient at alpha=13.87 deg, normalised by 0.5 rho_inf U_inf^2 c
cl.T_good_source: RANS-consensus mid-band; TMR per-model results span CL = 1.62 (SST) to 1.72 (SA), so 1.65 +- 0.10 covers all major published RANS predictions on this case. Experimental Coles-Wadcock ~ 1.49 is at the T_bad boundary, signalling that pure RANS is known to over-predict CL near max-lift.

cd.T_good_source: Wide tolerance because at near-stall, viscous + form drag is highly turbulence-model-dependent. Published RANS on this case range from CD ~ 0.022 to ~ 0.038 across SA/SST/SSG-LRR/Wilcox-2006. T_good = 0.008 (~27% of gt) is the cross-model 1-sigma scatter.

cp_at_xc_06_upper.description: Wall Cp on the upper (suction) surface at x/c = 0.6 (linear interpolation between agent's nearest tabulated wall stations)
cp_at_xc_06_upper.T_good_source: Plot-derived from naca4412.cp.expt.dat (Coles-Wadcock experimental Cp), upper-surface trace, by visual interpolation at x/c=0.6 from the published TMR figure: Cp ~ -0.85 at alpha=13.87 deg. T_good=0.20 absorbs both experimental scatter and turbulence-model spread on suction-side recovery.

separation_xc_upper.description: x/c on the upper surface where wall Cf first crosses from positive to negative (separation point)
separation_xc_upper.T_good_source: Coles-Wadcock 1979 reported separation between x/c=0.82 and 0.87; published RANS predictions span this band (SA ~ 0.86, SST ~ 0.81). gt = 0.825 is the cross-model midpoint; T_good = 0.05 covers the experimental + model spread.
